notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}.
Flubs triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Life from the Loam, returning nothing to your hand.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling three cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile Life from the Loam.
Flubs triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Lion's Eye Diamond.
Repeat.
